design: 2 scenes x 6 prompt families x 2 exact repetitions; fixed interleaved order
response_contract: Unconstrained text; retain verbatim. Separately extract recognition/action items as observed, not_observed, unknown or unparseable; do not run legacy incident parser on diagnostic prose.

experiments.prompt:
Describe this video in your own words, including the setting, visible people and their actions from beginning to end.
Use only visible evidence in this video. Do not infer authorization, criminal intent or hidden actions. Mark occluded or unresolved details as unknown. Describe observations before interpretations. Give approximate relative times only when supported; otherwise say timing unknown. Do not use an incident label as a substitute for describing what is visible.
